role: experimental: all new model fitting, baseline fits, attack fits, scoring
headline_verdict: The repair worked mathematically and failed scientifically. The objective is now exactly rotation invariant (gate 18/18, max share 1.4e-15 against a 0.10 threshold, where the predecessor measured mean 0.628), and the measured disclosure is WORSE, not better, than the defective objective it repairs. The predecessor's central forward-looking inference -- that removing the provably inert 63% of surrogate movement should let the same compute buy more -- is refuted by direct experiment. Three external baselines beat the repaired mechanism, and LEACE dominates it.
method_description: rotation_invariant_moment_refinement. The coordinate-dependent penalty is replaced by two exactly invariant components: a Frobenius-weighted quadratic moment block (off-diagonal monomials weighted sqrt(2), one scalar scale per role, NO centering) and an exact average of three Gaussian kernels on a frozen per-role subset of at most 512 representation-training rows (V-statistic, diagonal retained). Rotation acts as M -> Q'MQ on the first and preserves pairwise distances in the second, so with the already-invariant utility and linear terms the whole objective is a function on the Grassmannian. Everything else -- V, U, the anchor bases, the frozen household OOF nuisances, the policies, denominators, Stiefel solver, two deterministic starts, 200-update budget and training-objective-only selection -- is the predecessor's, unchanged.

changed_claims: The predecessor's 63% rotation slack is REPAIRED, not merely diagnosed; and that share is an ATTAINED value, never a bound or a causal decomposition.

The inference that removing the inert slack would buy more protection is REFUTED: the repaired arm leaks significantly MORE on coalition race at rank 16 and on local race, coalition sex and coalition race at rank 8, with no endpoint significantly better.

First method-level baselines exist. LEACE dominates the developed mechanism (significantly lower recovery on all four sensitive endpoints, no detectable residence cost, clears the source allowance 3/3 seeds vs 1-2/3). LEACE, SPLINCE and OptNet-C1 are statistically indistinguishable from J; the developed mechanism is significantly worse than J on 3 of 4.

The marginal spectral arms ARE SARL-style adaptations (bitwise rebuild), with one measured mismatch: per-attribute trace reweighting, not absorbable into lambda, moving the subspace by projector distance 0.10-0.20.
Protected-class support determines the realised width of a linearly erased channel: LEACE rank is 6, 6, 7 across seeds because seed 2 has a zero-support race category.
Terminal 2's corrections are adopted: the nlr8_C1 vs J A/SEX person-weighted deficit is +0.01210 not +0.0098; 'no endpoint significantly worse' is withdrawn.
unchanged_claims: The original locked 2017 transport result keeps its historical status; not relabelled, not restated, not overwritten.
2016 remains UNSCORED. Not scored, fitted, transformed, tuned on or inspected. No code path in this study can reach it.
r_plus = 16 in all three seeds; the sign rule changes nothing; rank 8 remains the predeclared compression alternative; no alias was refitted.
The coordination rule is a one-sided POINT-ESTIMATE rule; a pass is not equivalence and not noninferiority.

candidate_for_confirmation.reason: Nothing in this study's mechanism line merits confirmation. The one observation worth recording is that leace_A0 is the only arm matching J on every sensitive endpoint at no detectable residence cost -- a candidate OBSERVATION, not a nomination, and not a reason to spend 2016.
candidate_for_confirmation.2016: NOT AUTHORISED by this decision and not touched.

known_limitations_terminal_2_must_carry: All intervals are development uncertainty conditional on fitted systems; they cannot undo repeated use of the 2018 pools.
The kernel block has an m-dependent floor (METHOD.md 3.7); it does not bias arm comparisons but bounds absolute values.
A misspecified nuisance manufactures a penalty >10x the oracle under exact conditional independence, so a nonzero penalty is not evidence of disclosure.
SPLINCE Thm 2: it shares LEACE's kernel, so differences here come from attacker regularisation and nonlinearity, not a stronger guarantee. SPLINCE also sees two task labels no other arm uses.
The OptNet multi-lambda multi-attribute form is an extrapolation not present in its paper.

Sporadic in-memory prediction corruption occurred four times during the 2017 stage (captured signature: a probability row summing to exactly zero). Every occurrence was detected and aborted its unit before writing; no corrupted array reached any table. Memory pressure is SUSPECTED, not demonstrated.
2017 carries no intervals and excludes the erasure and OptNet baselines.
